title: 22 Flatwood Street Vacation Rental
meta_description: 22 Flatwood Street is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 22 Flatwood Street, a luxury WaterColor retreat designed for families and groups seeking space, comfort, and connection. This stunning three-story home in the Lake District accommodates up to 14 guests and includes a private pool, 6-passenger electric cart, and six adult bikes. Perfectly positioned near community pools and the Beach Club, it delivers the ideal balance of elegance and convenience for your 30A vacation.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 14 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Private Pool with Outdoor Pool Bathroom (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Covered Back Porch with Fireplace Built-In Stainless Natural Gas Grill Walk-In Exterior Shower Ping-Pong Table on Upstairs Porch Third-Floor Media Room Home Theater Surround Sound and Multi-Room Audio Two Laundry Rooms (First and Second Floors) 2 Blocks from the Frog Pool 3-Minute Bike Ride to the WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Step inside 22 Flatwood Street, where refined design and thoughtful details define this exceptional WaterColor residence. Spanning over 5,200 square feet, this home offers spacious living areas, a private pool, and a layout ideal for large families or groups traveling together. The open-concept main level welcomes guests with a bright living space and elegant furnishings. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, a large center island, and generous counter space, making it easy to prepare meals or gather for casual dining. The adjoining dining area seats the whole family, while the nearby covered back porch extends the living space outdoors with a cozy fireplace and built-in grill. The first-floor master suite offers a peaceful retreat with a king bed, soaking tub, and walk-in shower. A large laundry and mudroom add convenience, while a nearby half bath serves the main living area.On the second floor, guests will find two additional master suites, each with a king bed and private bathroom. A third bedroom includes three twin-over-twin bunk beds with its own full bath, ideal for children or additional guests. The third floor offers a private retreat with another king suite, twin beds, a half bath, and a media lounge featuring a large flat-screen TV and home theater surround sound. This floor also includes a kitchenette for added comfort and convenience. Outdoors, the private pool area is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Guests can enjoy the outdoor fireplace, covered seating, and flat-screen TV, as well as a pool bathroom and walk-in shower. The second-story porch offers a Ping-Pong table and additional space for recreation or leisure. Every area of this home is enhanced by advanced technology, including home theater surround sound, multi-room music, Apple TV, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Whether inside or out, guests can enjoy entertainment and connectivity in every corner.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Kitchen Large Laundry and Mudroom Half Bathroom Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Three Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 6), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Laundry Room Third Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Living Area: Twin Beds (Sleeps 2) Half Bathroom Life in WaterColor Located in the Lake District, 22 Flatwood Street offers quick access to the community’s scenic pools, parks, and nature trails. Guests are just a short bike ride from the WaterColor Beach Club, Seaside, and 30A’s best dining and shopping. Whether relaxing by the pool, exploring Western Lake, or enjoying the nearby Gulf beaches, this home provides the perfect setting for your WaterColor getaway. Guests may rent a cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor allows only one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
